Heart rhythm test

Electrocardiogram (ECG)

An electrocardiogram (ECG) is a quick, painless test that records the electrical activity of your heart.

What to Expect

  • The test usually takes 5 to 10 minutes.
  • Ten small stickers called electrodes will be placed on your chest, arms, and legs.
  • Please wear clothing that makes it easy to access your chest.
  • The electrodes are connected to the ECG machine by wires.
  • You will be asked to relax and stay still while your heart rhythm is recorded.
  • You will not feel anything from the ECG machine.
